name: Family Conflicts
overview: Scripture instructs believers to acknowledge the Lord in all their ways, trusting Him to guide their paths even amidst family conflicts. Jesus’ example of facing temptation in the wilderness reminds us that trials are part of the Christian journey. The teaching against retaliation, such as 'an eye for an eye,' calls believers to reject vengeance and instead pursue honest and honorable conduct toward others. This approach fosters peace and reflects Christ’s character within the family unit.
